title: Climate Policy Risk and Corporate Financial Decisions: Evidence from the NOx Budget Trading Program
eligible_reason: Single common date. nbp = 1 for firms headquartered in 11 SIP Call states (AL, IL, IN, KY, MI, NC, OH, SC, TN, VA, WV), and post = 1 if fyear >= 2004 for everyone (compustat_data_clean.do lines 307-315). Table 2 column 1 (b_lev on nbpxpost nbp post, firm + state + year FE) has no controls but only one cohort. Dynamic Table 5 uses nbp x year-relative dummies around 2004 with controls. The main Compustat panel is not shipped.
